data.name: Ibrahimu
data.gender_notes: Ibrahimu is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ibrahimu is derived from the Arabic name Ibrahim, meaning 'father of many' or 'exalted father'. It is associated with the Prophet Ibrahim, a significant figure in Islamic tradition. The name Ibrahimu carries the meaning “Father of many nations” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Hausa. Parents who choose Ibrahimu usually hope their child will grow to embody father of many nations and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Ibrahimu is linked to the Quranic narrative of Prophet Ibrahim, symbolizing faith, sacrifice, and devotion to Allah.
data.etymology: Ibrahimu belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of many nations.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibrahimu total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: إبراهيمو
